title: Unidade do Porto Digital em Portugal amplia participacao de empresas de Pernambuco na Europa (Diario de Pernambuco, 23 June 2026)
what_it_says: Diario de Pernambuco reports that Cais do Porto, Porto Digital's international unit in Aveiro, started in 2024 and that more than 45 Brazilian companies, most from Pernambuco, have passed through it.
